def process(reportsByType):
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportsByType.copy()

    # Row 1 contains the real headers; clean and re-header
    header = df.iloc[1].tolist()
    df = df.iloc[2:].copy()
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in header]

    # Keep only year rows; remove source/blank rows
    df = df[df['Year'].notna()].copy()

    # Parse numeric columns with thousands separators
    for col in ['Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']:
        df[col] = (
            df[col]
            .astype(str)
            .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
            .str.strip()
        )
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

    it_2001 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2001, 'Identity Theft'].iloc[0]
    it_2024 = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2024, 'Identity Theft'].iloc[0]

    ratio = it_2024 / it_2001
    return pd.DataFrame([{'ratio': ratio}])
